title: Nationalities — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: The nationalities used on employee records. An employee's nationality decides which social security (PIFSS) rules apply in payroll and how they count in the workforce quota.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: NameEn
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in English.

fields.label: NameAr
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in Arabic.

fields.label: NationalityGroup
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Nationality Group master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The group this nationality belongs to.

Why it matters. For the workforce quota under Government Relations, nationalities whose group is named Citizen count as citizens; all others count as non-citizens.
fields.adminHtml: Groups are maintained under General Master Info → Nationality Groups.
